Here, $A$ is a $2\times 3$ matrix and $B$ is a $3\times 2$ matrix. 

There are $3$ columns in $A$ and $3$ rows in $B,$ so $A$ and $B$ are conformable for multiplication:

$$
{A}_{2\times \boxed{\text{3}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{B}_{\boxed{\text{3}}\times 2}={AB}_{2\times 2}
$$

Let's compute $AB,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 & 2 \\ 6 & 5 \\ -3 & 4\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-15 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,-15=2\cdot (-3)+(-1)\cdot 6+1\cdot (-3) \\  & [\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 & 2 \\ 6 & 5 \\ -3 & 4\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-15 & 3 \\ ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,3=2\cdot 2+(-1)\cdot 5+1\cdot 4 \\  & [\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 & 2 \\ 6 & 5 \\ -3 & 4\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-15 & 3 \\ -9 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,-9=1\cdot (-3)+0\cdot 6+2\cdot (-3) \\  & [\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 & 2 \\ 6 & 5 \\ -3 & 4\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-15 & 3 \\ -9 & 10\end{aligned}], &  & \,10=1\cdot 2+0\cdot 5+2\cdot 4\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$AB=[\begin{aligned}-15 & 3 \\ -9 & 10\end{aligned}].$
